core_obligations: Reduce to the case where the leading coefficient of the first factor lifts to a unit (proof lines 1915-1917).
Rescale the two factors so that the first becomes monic and note that the second is then monic as well (proof lines 1918-1921).

proof_roadmap: Make the leading coefficient a unit (proof lines 1915-1917).
Rescale to the monic case (proof lines 1918-1921).
difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts a factorisation of the reduction of a monic polynomial, whose first factor has invertible leading coefficient and such that the two factors generate the unit ideal, after an etale ring map inducing an isomorphism on the quotient. The proof first makes the leading coefficient of the first factor the reduction of a unit, which is legitimate after the etale base change supplied by the lifting result for invertible elements, then rescales the two factors so that the first one becomes monic, which forces the second to be monic as well because the polynomial itself is monic, and finally applies the lifting statement for factorisations into monic polynomials.
